one-piece.name: One Piece
one-piece.asOf: Manga: chapter 1199 (Weekly Shonen Jump, 22-23 Nov 2026; mid-Elbaph arc). Anime: episode 1180 (27 Sep 2026), which adapts up to about chapter 1150; the anime is on break until 2027. Checked 25 Nov 2026.
one-piece.basis: Ranked by in-story status first (Emperor, Admiral, commander), then by on-page fight results and bounties inside each tier; we never use fan power-scaling, and where two characters never fought and the evidence can't separate them we say so.
one-piece.notes: How we ordered each tier: Top tier and Emperors go by bounty, except that a fight result wins over a bounty (Luffy beat Kaido, so he sits above him even though Kaido's bounty is higher). Shanks, Blackbeard and Luffy have never fought each other, so there is no canon order between them; they are listed by current bounty. Kizaru, Kuzan, Garp, Mihawk and Rayleigh have no head-to-head results except Akainu beating Kuzan and Kuzan beating Garp. Mihawk's 3.59 billion bounty is higher than Luffy's, but he is placed by status (former Warlord, not an Emperor). Law and Kid can't be separated (same bounty, same joint win), so they are listed by popularity. Commanders are listed by bounty: Doflamingo's 340 million is from before he became a Warlord, so his place there is low-confidence. Buggy is officially an Emperor (bounty 3,189,000,000, ch. 1053), but the story says he got the title through misunderstandings, the same way he became a Warlord, so we left him out of the ranking. Left out because the evidence is thinner: Sabo (his 602 million bounty comes from a magazine, and his Vivre Card says 'unknown'), Boa Hancock (1,659,000,000) and Crocodile (1,965,000,000), both Cross Guild or former Warlords with no recent decisive fight, and Jinbe (1.1 billion). Manga vs anime: the anime stopped at ep. 1180 (Domi Reversi, about ch. 1150) and returns in 2027, so Imu arriving at Elbaph, his fights with Zoro, Sanji and Loki, Luffy's new form and Sanji's Supreme King Haki (ch. 1179-1199) are manga-only. Spoiler flag: anything after Marineford is marked as a spoiler, so almost every entry is flagged, because bounties were revealed in Wano (ch. 957/1053/1058).

tiers.name: Top tier (legends of the last era)

chars.name: Gol D. Roger
chars.why: The Pirate King, the only pirate to sail the whole Grand Line; his 5,564,800,000-berry bounty, revealed in ch. 957 (ep. 958), is the highest ever recorded.

chars.name: Edward Newgate (Whitebeard)
chars.why: Called the "Strongest Man in the World" in the story, with a 5,046,000,000 bounty (ch. 957). At Marineford he kept fighting while ill and badly hurt, and died standing after Blackbeard's crew ganged up on him (ch. 576).

chars.name: Shanks
chars.why: One of the Four Emperors with the highest active Emperor bounty, 4,048,900,000 (ch. 957, ch. 1053). He ended the Marineford war just by arriving (ch. 580), beat Eustass Kid and Killer with a single strike (ch. 1079, ep. 1112), and made Admiral Ryokugyu back off Wano with his Haki alone (ch. 1055).

chars.name: Marshall D. Teach (Blackbeard)
chars.why: An Emperor with a bounty of 3,996,000,000 (ch. 1053, ep. 1080). He took Whitebeard's Devil Fruit power at Marineford, and later beat Trafalgar Law and the Heart Pirates at Winner Island (ch. 1064 and ch. 1081, ep. 1093 and ep. 1115). Shanks's eye scars came from an old fight with him (ch. 434).

chars.name: Monkey D. Luffy
chars.why: Named an Emperor with a 3,000,000,000 bounty after he defeated Kaido (ch. 1049, ep. 1076; ch. 1053, ep. 1080). He then fought Admiral Kizaru at Egghead until both were exhausted (ch. 1095, ep. 1129). In the Elbaph manga chapters, in a new form, he is now fighting Imu (ch. 1186-1199, ongoing).

chars.name: Kaido
chars.why: A former Emperor called the world's "Strongest Creature" (ch. 697). He had the highest active bounty of his time, 4,611,100,000 (ch. 957), and beat Luffy earlier in Wano, but lost the final fight to him on Onigashima (ch. 1049, ep. 1076).

chars.name: Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom)
chars.why: A former Emperor with a 4,388,000,000 bounty (ch. 957). Trafalgar Law and Eustass Kid defeated her together at Onigashima (ch. 1040, ep. 1067).

chars.name: Sakazuki (Akainu)
chars.why: Fleet Admiral of the Marines. He killed Ace and wounded Whitebeard at Marineford (ch. 574-576), then beat Kuzan in a 10-day duel for the Fleet Admiral seat (revealed in ch. 650, ep. 570).

chars.name: Borsalino (Kizaru)
chars.why: Admiral. He beat several of the Supernovas at Sabaody (ch. 507-510), and at Egghead fought Gear 5 Luffy, by then an Emperor, until both were exhausted (ch. 1095, ep. 1129).

chars.name: Kuzan (Aokiji)
chars.why: Former Admiral. He lost the 10-day duel with Akainu (ch. 650, ep. 570), and as a Blackbeard Pirates captain he ran Garp through with ice on Hachinosu (ch. 1088, ep. 1122), after which Garp was held prisoner (ch. 1126).

chars.name: Monkey D. Garp
chars.why: The Vice Admiral called the "Hero of the Marines". He fought Rocks alongside Roger at God Valley (from ch. 1096, with the rest shown in Elbaph-arc flashbacks), but was defeated by Kuzan and the Blackbeard Pirates on Hachinosu while covering his crew's escape (ch. 1088).

chars.name: Dracule Mihawk
chars.why: Holds the in-story title "World's Strongest Swordsman". He beat Zoro with one cut (ch. 51-52, ep. 24), and his bounty as a Cross Guild leader is 3,590,000,000 (ch. 1058, ep. 1086).

chars.name: Silvers Rayleigh
chars.why: Roger's first mate. He stepped in to hold off Admiral Kizaru at Sabaody so the Straw Hats could get away (ch. 511-512, ep. 403-404).

chars.name: Trafalgar Law
chars.why: Bounty 3,000,000,000 after he and Kid defeated Big Mom (ch. 1040, ep. 1067; ch. 1053). He then lost to Blackbeard at Winner Island (ch. 1064 and ch. 1081, ep. 1093 and ep. 1115).

chars.name: Eustass Kid
chars.why: Bounty 3,000,000,000 (ch. 1053, ep. 1080) after he and Law defeated Big Mom (ch. 1040). Shanks then beat him with a single strike at Elbaph (ch. 1079, ep. 1112).

chars.name: Marco
chars.why: Whitebeard's 1st division commander, with a bounty of 1,374,000,000. At Onigashima he held off King and Queen at the same time (ch. 1006, ep. 1022).

chars.name: Roronoa Zoro
chars.why: Bounty 1,111,000,000 (ch. 1058) after he beat King, Kaido's right-hand man, with a Supreme King Haki-coated attack (ch. 1035).

chars.name: Charlotte Katakuri
chars.why: Big Mom's Sweet Commander, with a bounty of 1,057,000,000. He lost to Luffy after a long fight in the Mirro-World (ch. 896, ep. 871).

chars.name: Sanji
chars.why: Bounty 1,032,000,000 (ch. 1058) after he beat Queen (ch. 1035). In the Elbaph manga chapters he used Supreme King Haki to break Killingham's armor and then his neck (ch. 1198-1199).

chars.name: Portgas D. Ace
chars.why: Whitebeard's 2nd division commander, with a 550,000,000 bounty, the highest shown in the first half of the story. He lost to Blackbeard on Banaro Island (ch. 440-441) and was killed by Akainu at Marineford (ch. 574).

chars.name: Donquixote Doflamingo
chars.why: A Warlord and the ruler of Dressrosa. Luffy beat him in Gear 4 to end the Dressrosa arc (ch. 790-791).

tiers.name: Not ranked yet (fight still going on in the manga)

chars.name: Imu (Saint Nerona Imu)
chars.why: The secret "King of the World". At Elbaph (manga only) he brushed off Zoro, overpowered Sanji (ch. 1180) and struck Loki down (ch. 1198). His Domi Reversi did nothing to Luffy and Loki (ch. 1178), he admits he has reached his limit away from Mary Geoise (ch. 1198), and his fight with Luffy has no result yet.

naruto.name: Naruto
naruto.asOf: Naruto is complete: the manga ended with ch. 700 (Nov 2014) and Naruto Shippuden ended with ep. 500 (Mar 2017). Chapter numbers are from the manga. Checked 25 Nov 2026.
naruto.basis: Ranked by on-page fight results and official titles (Hokage, Kazekage) in Naruto and Shippuden, plus explicit in-story statements; Boruto is kept out of the ranking and covered only in the note.
naruto.notes: Ordering: Naruto and Sasuke only beat Kaguya together, so the three can't be split one-on-one; we list them by popularity, with Naruto first because Sasuke conceded their final fight. Inside the legendary Kage tier, Hashirama is first because he beat Madara outright. Guy, Minato and Tobirama never fought each other; Guy is second because of the Night Guy result. In the Kage tier, Pain is first because he beat Jiraiya and Kakashi, Itachi second because he beat Kakashi and sealed Orochimaru. Jiraiya, Orochimaru, Kakashi and Tsunade have no head-to-head results with each other, so after the listed fights they are ordered by popularity. Deidara sits above Gaara because he beat him, though the story notes that Gaara spent his chakra shielding the village. Konan and Sasori have no canon order. Pain and Itachi only meet when the reanimated Itachi, Naruto and Killer B seal the reanimated Nagato (ch. 548-552), so that isn't a clean one-on-one. Left out for thin on-page evidence: Shisui Uchiha (slug shisui-uchiha), whose 'Shisui of the Body Flicker' reputation and 'strongest Uchiha' praise mostly come from the novels and an OVA rather than manga fights; also Hiruzen, the Fourth Raikage, Ōnoki, Kisame and Kabuto, who have no slugs. Spoiler flag: any evidence from the Fourth Great Ninja War (about ch. 515 onward) is marked as a spoiler, including the identity of the masked man as Obito (ch. 599). BORUTO (separate; not ranked): in Boruto: Naruto Next Generations, Naruto loses Kurama after using Baryon Mode against Isshiki Ōtsutsuki, and Sasuke loses his Rinnegan in the same arc. Later Kawaki seals Naruto and Hinata away in a pocket dimension. Boruto: Two Blue Vortex (from Aug 2023) is still running, so any Boruto-era ranking would change month to month; we keep it out of this page.

chars.name: Naruto Uzumaki
chars.why: Given Six Paths power by Hagoromo (ch. 671), he sealed Kaguya together with Sasuke (ch. 690). Their final battle ended with both losing an arm and Sasuke admitting defeat, and he becomes the Seventh Hokage (ch. 700).

chars.name: Sasuke Uchiha
chars.why: Received the Rinnegan and Six Paths power (ch. 671-672), and sealed Kaguya with Naruto (ch. 690). He fought Naruto to a mutual standstill at the Valley of the End and then conceded.

chars.name: Kaguya Ōtsutsuki
chars.why: The progenitor of chakra and the final villain. It took Naruto and Sasuke's combined Six Paths – Chibaku Tensei, with help from Sakura and Kakashi, to seal her (ch. 690).

chars.name: Madara Uchiha
chars.why: Reanimated, he defeated all five Kage by himself (ch. 601), then beat the tailed beasts, became the Ten-Tails' jinchūriki and survived Guy's Night Guy (ch. 658-672), before Black Zetsu betrayed him to revive Kaguya.

chars.name: Tobi (the masked man)
chars.why: As the masked man he forced Konan to burn through his Izanagi (ch. 509-510), and he became the Ten-Tails' jinchūriki (ch. 637-639). It took the whole Allied Shinobi Forces, led by Naruto and Sasuke, to bring him down, and Madara said he could overpower him (ch. 656). (The masked man is revealed to be Obito Uchiha in ch. 599.)

chars.name: Hashirama Senju
chars.why: The First Hokage, called the "God of Shinobi". He beat Madara and the Nine-Tails at what became the Valley of the End (flashback, ch. 626), and Madara admitted he was weaker than Hashirama all his life.

chars.name: Might Guy
chars.why: Opening all Eight Gates, his Night Guy kick nearly killed the Ten-Tails jinchūriki Madara, who called him the strongest taijutsu user he had ever faced (ch. 672). The technique cost Guy the use of his leg.

chars.name: Minato Namikaze
chars.why: The Fourth Hokage. During the Nine-Tails attack he drove off the masked man and sealed the fox, giving his life to do it (ch. 500-503).

chars.name: Tobirama Senju
chars.why: The Second Hokage, who created Edo Tensei and the Flying Thunder God. He died as a decoy against the Kinkaku Force after passing the title to Hiruzen (ch. 481), and was reanimated to fight alongside the other Hokage in the Fourth War.

chars.name: Kurama (Nine-Tails)
chars.why: Hashirama captured it, and Minato sealed it after it attacked Konoha (ch. 500-503). In the war, the reanimated Madara outfought it and the other tailed beasts (ch. 658-661).

chars.name: Pain (Nagato)
chars.why: Leader of Akatsuki. He killed Jiraiya (ch. 372-383), killed Kakashi and flattened Konoha, then was defeated by Sage Mode Naruto (ch. 422-449).

chars.name: Itachi Uchiha
chars.why: Beat Kakashi with Tsukuyomi (ch. 142-143) and sealed Orochimaru with the Totsuka Blade during his last fight with Sasuke, which ended with Itachi dying of illness (ch. 384-393).

chars.name: Jiraiya
chars.why: One of the Legendary Sannin. He made Itachi and Kisame retreat (ch. 147-148), and died fighting Pain's six bodies in Sage Mode (ch. 372-383).

chars.name: Orochimaru
chars.why: One of the Legendary Sannin. He fought the Third Hokage to the death during the Konoha Crush, losing the use of his arms, and Itachi sealed him away (ch. 392).

chars.name: Kakashi Hatake
chars.why: Becomes the Sixth Hokage (ch. 700). He lost to Itachi (ch. 142-143) and was killed by Pain before being revived (ch. 422-449), and fought Kaguya with Team 7 using power lent by Obito (ch. 686-691).

chars.name: Tsunade
chars.why: The Fifth Hokage and one of the Legendary Sannin. She was one of the five Kage the reanimated Madara defeated by himself in the Fourth War (ch. 601).

chars.name: Deidara
chars.why: An Akatsuki member who beat and captured the Fifth Kazekage Gaara (ch. 249-252), who was busy shielding his village. He died by blowing himself up against Sasuke, who survived (ch. 357-362).

chars.name: Gaara
chars.why: The Fifth Kazekage. He lost to Deidara while protecting Sunagakure (ch. 249-252), and in the war he was one of the five Kage Madara defeated (ch. 601).

chars.name: Konan
chars.why: Pain's partner in Akatsuki. Against the masked man she forced him to use Izanagi, at the cost of an eye, before he killed her (ch. 509-510).

chars.name: Sasori
chars.why: An Akatsuki puppet master who was defeated by Sakura and his grandmother Chiyo working together (ch. 264-280).

dragon-ball.name: Dragon Ball
dragon-ball.basis: Ranked only by official titles and in-story statements (Omni-King, Angels, Gods of Destruction, Toyotaro's official Black Frieza statement) and by on-screen or on-page fight results in Dragon Ball, Z, Super (anime, films and Toyotaro's manga); GT and Daima are kept out of the tiers and covered in notes.
dragon-ball.notes: Coverage: the Super anime ended at episode 131 (Tournament of Power, March 2018) and continued in two films, Broly (2018) and Super Hero (2022). Toyotaro's manga goes beyond the anime with the Galactic Patrol Prisoner/Moro arc (to ch. 67), the Granolah the Survivor arc (to ch. 87, which introduces Black Frieza) and its own Super Hero adaptation (to ch. 103, March 2024). Chapter 104 (Feb 2025) is a one-shot, and the manga is on hiatus as of late 2026. Everything that rests only on the manga is marked spoiler. 'Dragon Ball Super: Beerus', a remake of the Battle of Gods arc, has aired since 11 Oct 2026; 'Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol', which adapts the Moro arc, was announced in Jan 2026 with no date yet. Ordering: inside the manga-peak tier, Frieza and then Gas come first because of direct results; Goku, Vegeta, Gohan and Broly have no canon order among themselves. Gods of Destruction are placed above that tier by title only, since no manga-era fight has settled Beerus against Black Frieza or Ultra Instinct Goku. Not ranked: Gogeta and Vegito (fusions; Gogeta beat Broly in the 2018 film, and Vegito fought Merged Zamasu), Granolah (wished to be the universe's strongest and was later out-powered by Gas), Bardock, Krillin and Bulma (non-combatant). DRAGON BALL GT (1996–97) is an anime-original sequel not written by Toriyama and conflicts with Super, so treat it as non-canon: SSJ4 Gogeta beats Omega Shenron in its finale, but that has no place in these tiers. DRAGON BALL DAIMA (Oct 2024–Feb 2025, story by Akira Toriyama) is officially placed between the Buu saga and Super. Goku uses Super Saiyan 4 to beat Gomah there, but those characters are de-aged and the form never shows up in Super, so Daima results are left out of the tiers. Where it sits in the canon is debated by fans, and no official statement has settled it.

chars.name: Zeno
chars.why: Has the highest title in the multiverse (Omni-King), and in Super he erases whole universes, the losing universes in the Tournament of Power and, as Future Zeno, the entire future timeline with Merged Zamasu (Future Trunks arc, ep 66–67). He never fights anyone, so he ranks first on authority and erasure rather than on a fight.

chars.name: Grand Priest
chars.why: Father of all Angels and Zeno's attendant; Whis openly says his own power is nothing next to the Grand Priest's, and in manga chapter 29 he stops punches from the Gods of Destruction Beerus and Quitela with his fingers.

chars.name: Whis
chars.why: Beerus' martial-arts teacher. Beerus himself says Whis is stronger than him (Battle of Gods; manga ch. 4), and Whis knocks out a rampaging Beerus with a single chop.

tiers.name: Gods of Destruction

chars.name: Beerus
chars.why: God of Destruction of Universe 7; in Battle of Gods (Super, Battle of Gods arc) he beats Super Saiyan God Goku without using his full power, and Whis is the only Universe 7 character stated to be above him.

tiers.note: Placed above the manga's peak forms by title only: no fight in the anime or manga settles Beerus against Black Frieza, Ultra Instinct or Ultra Ego.

tiers.name: Black Frieza / Ultra Instinct / Ultra Ego / Beast (manga peak)

chars.name: Frieza
chars.why: As Black Frieza (manga ch. 87) he kills the wished-up Gas with one stab, then floors Ultra Instinct Goku and Ultra Ego Vegeta with one hit each; Toyotaro said on Dragon Ball Official that Black Frieza is clearly above Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, Broly and Piccolo in their strongest forms.

chars.name: Gas
chars.why: The Heeters used the Dragon Balls to wish Gas into 'the strongest in the universe' (Granolah the Survivor arc); he then out-powered True Ultra Instinct Goku and Ultra Ego Vegeta fighting together, until Black Frieza killed him (ch. 87).

chars.name: Goku
chars.why: Mastered Ultra Instinct overwhelmed Jiren in the Tournament of Power (anime ep 129–131); in the manga he defeated Moro with Ultra Instinct and fought Gas with True Ultra Instinct before Black Frieza beat him in one blow.

chars.name: Vegeta
chars.why: Ultra Ego, the God of Destruction-style form taught by Beerus (manga only), let him fight Granolah and then Gas alongside Goku; he eliminated Top in the Tournament of Power, and Black Frieza beat him in one hit (ch. 87).

chars.name: Gohan
chars.why: His Beast form defeats Cell Max in Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero (2022 film, also adapted in the manga), after Orange Piccolo and the others could not.

chars.name: Broly
chars.why: In Dragon Ball Super: Broly (2018) neither Super Saiyan Blue Goku nor Vegeta could beat him alone; it took the fusion Gogeta to overpower him. Toyotaro names him with Goku, Vegeta and Gohan as below Black Frieza.

chars.name: Jiren
chars.why: Universe 11's Pride Trooper is stated to have surpassed his own God of Destruction, Belmod. He eliminated Hit and Vegeta in the Tournament of Power and lost only to Mastered Ultra Instinct Goku plus Frieza, going out of the ring together with them (ep 131).

chars.name: Moro
chars.why: A planet-eating sorcerer who matched Ultra Instinct Sign Goku and then took Merus's Angel-level power before Ultra Instinct Goku destroyed him at the end of the Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc (manga; anime announced, not aired).

chars.name: Toppo
chars.why: Universe 11's God of Destruction candidate, called second only to Jiren (ep 125). He used Destroyer power until Vegeta's Final Explosion eliminated him.

chars.name: Android 17
chars.why: The last fighter standing who won the Tournament of Power for Universe 7 (ep 131), then used the Super Dragon Balls to restore the erased universes.

chars.name: Hit
chars.why: Universe 6's time-skipping assassin made Goku forfeit their match in the Universe 6 vs 7 tournament (ep 39) and eliminated several fighters in the Tournament of Power before Jiren knocked him out.

chars.name: Piccolo
chars.why: His Orange Piccolo form in Super Hero (2022) fights Gamma 2 and holds back Cell Max, but cannot beat it alone; Toyotaro's list puts it below Black Frieza alongside the Saiyans.

chars.name: Future Trunks
chars.why: In the Future Trunks arc he reaches Super Saiyan Rage and cuts Merged Zamasu in two with the Spirit Sword (ep 66), although Zeno's erasure is what finally ends Zamasu.

chars.name: Majin Buu
chars.why: Kid Buu, his pure form, destroyed the Earth and was beaten only by Goku's Super Spirit Bomb (Kid Buu saga, Z).

chars.name: Cell
chars.why: Perfect Cell outlasted Goku at the Cell Games (Goku conceded the match) and lost only to Super Saiyan 2 Gohan's Father–Son Kamehameha (Cell Games saga, Z).

chars.name: Android 18
chars.why: One of Universe 7's last survivors in the Tournament of Power: she eliminated Ribrianne and others, then took herself out to save Android 17 (anime).

jujutsu-kaisen.name: Jujutsu Kaisen
jujutsu-kaisen.basis: Ranked only by official grades (special grade, grade 1 and so on), explicit in-story titles ('the strongest' Gojo, Sukuna as King of Curses) and by fight results in the finished manga (ch. 0–271) and Jujutsu Kaisen 0, with fights that the anime has not yet adapted marked as spoilers.
jujutsu-kaisen.notes: The manga ended with ch. 271 (Weekly Shonen Jump, 30 Sep 2024). Anime as of Nov 2026: S1 (2020–21), the Jujutsu Kaisen 0 film (2021), S2 Hidden Inventory/Shibuya (2023) and S3 'The Culling Game Part 1', which aired 8/9 Jan to 26/27 Mar 2026 (12 episodes, ending with ep 12 'Sendai Colony'). So Culling Game Part 1 did air in Jan 2026. Part 2 (S4) is announced with no date, so the Hakari vs Kashimo fight, the Sakurajima colony, the Shinjuku Showdown (Gojo vs Sukuna, ch. 223–236) and the finale are manga-only. The Zenin clan massacre and Yuji vs Higuruma have now aired. Per AniLumi policy, anything from Shibuya onward is marked spoiler. Not ranked: Rika (special grade curse bound to Yuta), Mahoraga (a shikigami), Uro, Ishigori, Yorozu, Naobito (special grade 1), Mei Mei (grade 1), Panda (semi-grade 2) and Miwa. Ordering inside tiers follows direct results where they exist (Sukuna over Gojo, Yuta over Kenjaku, Kenjaku over Yuki, Hakari over Kashimo); in the special grade curse tier and between Toji and Maki there is no canon order. Yuji is placed in the special grade tier, not the top tier, because Sukuna was already worn down by the many fighters before him.

chars.name: Sukuna
chars.why: The King of Curses, called the strongest sorcerer in history, killed Gojo in the Shinjuku Showdown (ch. 223–236) and then beat Kashimo, Higuruma and Yuta in turn, until a combined assault ending with Yuji destroyed him in ch. 268.

chars.name: Satoru Gojo
chars.why: Special grade, called 'the strongest' sorcerer of the modern era. He killed Toji (ch. 75, ep 28) and outclassed Jogo and Hanami, was sealed by Kenjaku in Shibuya (ch. 90–91), and lost to Sukuna in the Shinjuku Showdown when the world-cutting slash killed him (ch. 236).

chars.name: Yuji Itadori
chars.why: He landed the decisive blows of the final fight: his domain and soul-strike forced Sukuna out of Megumi's body, and Sukuna was reduced to dust (ch. 268).

chars.name: Yuta Okkotsu
chars.why: One of only four special grade sorcerers. He beat Suguru Geto in Jujutsu Kaisen 0, beheaded Kenjaku with Todo's help (ch. 243), and fought Sukuna using Gojo's body.

chars.name: Kenjaku
chars.why: A thousand-year-old curse user in Geto's body. He killed the special grade Yuki Tsukumo while also holding off Choso (ch. 207–208), then died in Yuta's surprise attack (ch. 243).

chars.name: Yuki Tsukumo
chars.why: Listed as one of only four special grade sorcerers (ch. 77, ep 29). She lost to Kenjaku but ended the fight with a black hole (ch. 208).

chars.name: Suguru Geto
chars.why: A special grade curse user who led the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons; Yuta and Rika defeated him and Gojo finished him (Jujutsu Kaisen 0).

chars.name: Mahito
chars.why: Unregistered special grade curse who killed Nanami in Shibuya (ch. 120); Yuji and Todo beat him (ch. 126–133) and Kenjaku absorbed him (Shibuya Incident, anime S2).

chars.name: Jogo
chars.why: Unregistered special grade curse; Gojo outclassed him easily (ch. 14–15, ep 7), and in Shibuya Sukuna killed him in a one-on-one fight while praising his strength.

tiers.name: Heavenly Restriction and Culling Game top players (no official grade)

chars.name: Toji Fushiguro
chars.why: The Sorcerer Killer with zero cursed energy. He beat and stabbed teenage Gojo (ch. 72, ep 27) but died to the awakened Gojo (ch. 75, ep 28, Hidden Inventory arc).

chars.name: Maki Zenin
chars.why: Mai's death completed Maki's Heavenly Restriction, and she wiped out the Zenin clan's Hei, including Naoya and Ogi (ch. 148–151, adapted in S3 'Cog'). She later fought Sukuna in Shinjuku.

chars.name: Kinji Hakari
chars.why: Beat the 400-year-old Kashimo in Tokyo Colony 2, surviving a fatal blow by hitting his jackpot (ch. 185–189, not yet animated).

chars.name: Hajime Kashimo
chars.why: The 'God of Lightning', the first Culling Game player to challenge Sukuna right after Gojo's death; he forced Sukuna into his true form but died.

chars.name: Hiromi Higuruma
chars.why: Culling Game player who put Yuji on trial in his Deadly Sentencing domain (ch. 163–166, S3), and later won the Executioner's Sword against Sukuna before Sukuna took him out of the fight (ch. 244–246).

chars.name: Aoi Todo
chars.why: Grade 1 sorcerer; with Yuji he beat the special grade Mahito in Shibuya (ch. 126–133), and his Boogie Woogie helped Yuta kill Kenjaku (ch. 243).

chars.name: Kento Nanami
chars.why: Grade 1 sorcerer who fought Mahito with no winner in their first clash (ch. 21–29, S1) and was killed by Mahito in Shibuya (ch. 120).

chars.name: Choso
chars.why: An incarnated special grade cursed object (Death Painting No. 1). As a sorcerer he is not ranked special grade himself; he beat Yuji in Shibuya and later fought Kenjaku alongside Yuki.

chars.name: Megumi Fushiguro
chars.why: Officially grade 2. Sukuna treated his Ten Shadows as the key to his plans, and Megumi summoned Mahoraga in Shibuya (ch. 117); Sukuna then used his body in the Culling Game, so these are mostly Sukuna's feats.

chars.name: Toge Inumaki
chars.why: Semi-grade 1 since 2018. His Cursed Speech held off Geto's curses in Jujutsu Kaisen 0 and Hanami at the Goodwill Event.

chars.name: Nobara Kugisaki
